title: Connected-platform tool table (ADR 0006 §5.2)
description: An adapter's declared tool table, shipped and reviewed with the adapter (C2): every tool maps to exactly one effect of {read, draft, send} plus the scopes a grant must cover, and the table is pinned to the platform manifest version it was reviewed against. A table that fails this schema is a defective declaration — calls through it still gate as send (C3); validity is a review property, never a gate bypass. `label` is display-only (§5.2's AgenticOS class mapping) and never a gate input. `tools[].tool` values must be unique; uniqueness is asserted by the consumer (JSON Schema cannot express it).

$schema.description: Inert annotation: a URI naming the schema this document claims.

$comment.description: Inert annotation: free-form note carried by the document.

manifest_version.description: The platform manifest version this table was reviewed against (AOS-52 for AgenticOS). A call made while the platform reports a different — or no — manifest version gates as send (§5.2, C3 applied per version). The call never carries the version; it is platform-reported.

platform.description: The platform name this adapter serves (e.g. cloudflare, agenticos, fixture).

tools.description: One declaration per tool. Unique on `tool` (checked by the consumer).

tool.description: The adapter tool name as exposed to agents (MCP tool name).

effect.description: Exactly one of read|draft|send (C1). A tool missing this field, or carrying any other value, is malformed: calls against it gate as send (C3).

scopes.description: The platform scopes a call must sit inside; the proxy checks the caller's grant (§5.3) before any traffic. May be empty only for tools needing no scope beyond the enrollment.

label.description: Optional. The platform's own effect class where it differs from cadence's vocabulary (§5.2's AgenticOS mapping). Display only — never a gate input.
